limitations: Declared applicability does not manufacture absent source models or semantic facts.
Canonical names count families; TLA+ and Datalog authorization profiles are not extra families.
All40 inventory is not a claim that all40 adapters exist.
Security protocol example is exercised in focused tests; the compact artifact case here contains the other explicit typed routes.
Supplemental models and native Legal bridge fixture records are authored declarations, not independently executed extraction or source-fidelity proofs.
UI state projection refuses unknown guards, effects, timing, parallel joins and recovery. Legacy EC payloads with omitted guard/effect/recovery semantics remain visible but cannot train in v2.
Supplied event traces are incomplete and unverified; absent propositions remain unknown.
TLA output retains64-step underapproximation, generated diagnostic BoundedProgress and fairness limits; no parser, TLC, Lake or prover ran in this audit.
Frozen v1 module hash is preserved; existing checkpoint producer files were not edited.

review.finding: No concrete readiness-integration defect found; optimization excludes non-ready native targets, native/source histories remain separate, and validation selection is distinct from fitting.

scope: structural typed IR training targets; neither source decoding qualification nor theorem proof

actual_native_route_cases: UI event-labelled StateTransitionIR + native bounded TLA compiler
UI finite-prefix TraceIR with explicit unknown absent propositions
UI explicitly supplied ProgramIR and bound ProgramContract
Legal and other-domain supplied AuthorizationIR native roundtrip
Legal supplied LTL TemporalFormula native roundtrip
Security ProtocolIR, ConcurrencyIR, RefinementIR native roundtrip
stale embedded and external SourceRef refusal
v2 readiness exclusion for known-loss legacy UI event-calculus targets
